items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: But the style he played on the record, that's the style that Thereto Poino used to play around here.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. He had to bring me back home too. Yeah. Yeah. Also, this drummer lived back on Gravity Street with that Peter Williams. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He had to bring me back home too. Mm-hmm. You know.
Another thing you were telling us was that Earl Bostic, you say, got a lot of his stuff from you now.

Well, Earl Bostic was very fast on the saxophone. Very fast. Very good musician and everything. But the style he played on the record, that's the style that Thereto Poino used to play around here. Yeah. That's the style. Every time I heard Earl Bostic's record, I said that. That's right. Have you seen Pernell lately or? I saw him at the banquet we had. Oh, yeah.
